npm.description: Wait as long as pnpm does before proposing an npm update: Renovate reads pnpm's minimumReleaseAge and minimumReleaseAgeExclude from pnpm-workspace.yaml (pnpm's default of 1 day when unset), and strict filtering opens no branch or PR until a release is old enough, listing it on the Dependency Dashboard meanwhile.

packageRules.description: Hold the opentelemetry group on the SDK 2 line, which runs on @opentelemetry/api 1.9.x: eve 1.5 bundles its own @opentelemetry/api 1.9.1, and two API copies in one process make eve's tracer registration fail, so the function exits. Each range stops a package family below its SDK 3 release, so SDK 2 patch and minor updates still arrive grouped. Lift these holds once eve uses @opentelemetry/api 1.10; the branch fm/adam-otel-sdk3-awaiting-eve then carries the SDK 3 update.
SDK 2 hold, see the @opentelemetry/api rule: the SDK 3 releases of these start at 0.300.0.
SDK 2 hold, see the @opentelemetry/api rule: the SDK 3 releases of these start at 3.0.0.
SDK 2 hold, see the @opentelemetry/api rule: the SDK 3 release of this starts at 0.35.0.

eve and the Upstash AgentKit extension are a matched pair: the extension's _manifest.json declares the eve release it was built with and its distribution contract, and `eve build` fails when the installed eve is older than that release or does not support that contract. Group them so neither moves alone.
